targetAudience: Parents, gift-givers, kids of all ages, families, and adults including kidults — anyone who buys or enjoys toys, spanning all age groups from children to nostalgic adults
doList: Feature bold Toys"R"Us branding with straightforward messaging for maximum impact
Ensure toys always take center stage as the hero of all visuals
Speak directly to adults using relevant and straightforward language focused on product details and features
Make purchasing simple and intuitive across web, social, and email
Use punchy, accessible language with bold graphics and clear calls to action
Ensure links and key information are always easy to find
Use Geoffrey across campaigns to create dynamic brand presence
Use 3D elements, drop shadows, sparkles, and metallic hues especially during Q4 and holiday season
Use lifestyle imagery featuring kids, families, and adults with toys as the central focus
Pair Futura and Futura Bold with complementary seasonal fonts
Use platform bases and stages to give toys an elevated, dynamic display
Incorporate seasonal icons, borders, and environments tailored to each holiday
Use embellishments like glows, drop shadows, and glittery bursts to add depth
Align campaigns to position holidays, promote newness, and harness trends
Use product photography creatively as iconography within 3D scenes for vendor-specific ads
Use interactive social copy such as polls to drive engagement
dontList: Never allow products to overlap or touch the messaging in layouts
Do not show Geoffrey holding or endorsing specific products
Avoid complex or unclear language — messaging must be simple and intuitive
Do not remove focus from toys as the central element in all visuals
visualDirection: Dynamic 3D aesthetic with reimagined 3D Geoffrey, icons, borders, and environments. Core palette includes bold blues, reds, greens, oranges, and yellows (#004ebc, #f01446, #66bc29, #ff7000, #ffd200) with complementary whites, blacks, and gold tones. Features drop shadows, sparkles, metallic hues, glows, and embossed textures for depth and vibrancy. Lifestyle imagery integrates kids, families, and adults with toys as hero. Futura and Futura Bold are primary fonts. Visual approach is elevated yet fun, with clean professional layouts, linear shapes, and dynamic movement across digital, print, and in-store executions.
competitivePositioning: Toys"R"Us positions itself as the trusted, authoritative leader in play for all ages — not just children — embracing parents, gift-givers, and adults (including kidults). The brand differentiates through inclusivity, a sophisticated yet playful visual identity, trend-driven product curation, nostalgic brand equity via Geoffrey, and a seamless omnichannel shopping experience across in-store, web, social, and email.
campaignNotes: 2025 holiday tentpoles span the full calendar year with dedicated campaigns for Valentine's Day, Ramadan & Eid Al-Fitr, Easter/Spring, Outdoors, Back to School, Diwali, Halloween, Children's Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Hanukkah, Christmas, and Lunar New Year. Q4 and the holiday season receive elevated treatment with metallic hues, sparkles, and heightened 3D visual production. The Lebanon market guide reflects cultural inclusivity by incorporating Ramadan, Eid, and Diwali alongside Western holidays. Geoffrey is introduced in 10+ new 3D poses for use year-round. A new sophisticated font has been introduced in 2025 to complement existing brand-approved fonts. The overarching 2025 brand message is: 'In 2025, we will reach everyone, every day, with an exciting opportunity to purchase toys.'
